objective: Define a revision-bound, explicit AR trigger that opens a TUI session for user requests, proposal review, mandatory approval, or agent uncertainty.
assumptions: TUI is a downstream presentation and input client
unknowns: Transport and process supervision are deployment-specific
invariants: A trigger is explicitly interaction_required and never inferred from ordinary AR status
The trigger binds to one task revision
Only a valid AWG request reference can open a TUI session
Clarification does not resolve the underlying decision
Coordinator alone persists terminal trigger state
acceptance_predicates: All four user or agent activation cases have distinct values
Malformed or stale trigger data fails validation
A TUI response can be correlated by task, revision, request, and contract version
A clarification response leaves the trigger pending for follow-up
